critical_code_review_comments: AdminRoutes.jsx — clean separation: g(el) helper wraps every entry in <ProtectedRoute adminOnly>, including the /admin/chat redirect (g(<Navigate to='/chat' replace/>)) which is correct because it ensures only admins can be 'silently' bounced through this path. The /admin → /admin/analytics redirect is intentionally NOT wrapped in g() — fine because Navigate has no side effects and ProtectedRoute will gate the destination anyway.

constants/adminNav.js — pure data module, lucide icons imported once and reused, label-to-testid derivation lives in Layout.jsx (label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-')) so the 19 admin-nav-* test-ids are deterministic and stable across future label edits as long as labels stay textually unchanged. Verified live: 'System wallet · Treasury' → admin-nav-system-wallet-treasury, 'UPI payments (pending)' → admin-nav-upi-payments-pending — exactly as the request anticipated.
App.js — 83 lines, single adminRoutes.map() block, wildcard '*' route is last (correct ordering vs. /admin paths), public /legal/:kind route correctly placed before guarded user routes.

No behavioral regressions detected; pure file-organization refactor was successful. .env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was correctly set to https://network-pay-1.emergent.host during this run (the drift flagged in iterations 5/7 did NOT recur this iteration).
